reviews.t: Le meilleur pain au chocolat et les dames d’accueil sont toujours très gentilles!

This little boulangerie was near our accommodation for our almost three week holiday and it was lovely having it close by. From yummy croissants and pain au chocolat in the morning, to the fresh baked tradition baguettes quiche or a salad after a long day sightseeing, it was always possible to find something satisfying, tasty and well priced. Not to mention the desserts! The tartlette framboise or tarte au citron were favourites.

The lovely staff were always tolerant of our French (or lack of lol) and our inability to choose from their range. Merci beaucoup ladies, your kindness was appreciated!
Très bonnes viennoiseries et cookies au top !
Très bonne boulangerie, j’aime beaucoup leurs viennoiseries et le pain. 1 étoiles en moins pour l’accueil, c’est dommage
Went here each morning during a local stay and each croissant and pain chocolat I ordered was very tasty.
Pain au chocolat cher (1,5€) et très moyen au niveau du goût, rapport qualité prix mauvais.
Ils osent appeler cela des viennoiseries…
